scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pydemia/ui && npm run typecheck -w @pydemia/profile-demo && npm run typecheck -w @pydemia/docs
scripts.build: npm run registry:build && npm run build -w @pydemia/ui && node scripts/build-site.mjs
scripts.registry:check: node scripts/check-registry.mjs && node scripts/registry-release.mjs verify && node --test scripts/registry-release.test.mjs
scripts.registry:release-check: npm run registry:check && node scripts/registry-release.mjs verify-current
scripts.registry:snapshot: npm run registry:check && node scripts/registry-release.mjs create
